description: Foreman board: herdr plugin panes for the blocked drain, proposal review, and board

scripts.//target: bun, not node: every consumer invokes `bun`, and --target node miscompiles this package — a single-entry build crashes on bun's CJS entry guard, and a multi-entry build decodes string literals as Latin-1 (an em dash became 3 chars, so widths and rules were wrong too).
